children: ) Anthropic is moving to preserve founder control ahead of a potential blockbuster IPO, seeking shareholder approval for a structure that would give CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders a combined 50.1% of voting power.

The proposed setup would create a special class of shares giving the seven founders control over most corporate matters, provided at least three of them continue to hold a minimum number of shares. The structure is modeled on Palantir's founder-control system.
There is one notable limit: the founders would not control the election of Anthropic's board members.
Anthropic currently has a seven-seat board, with one seat vacant. The company also plans to give employees a separate class of stock that could serve as a tie-breaker on some corporate matters.

The timing matters because Anthropic is preparing for a potential public listing that could value the Claude maker at around $2 trillion, potentially putting it among the largest IPOs ever attempted. Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs are among the banks expected to play leading roles.
The governance proposal effectively asks future investors to accept reduced influence over key corporate decisions in exchange for exposure to one of the fastest-growing AI companies.
That trade-off is increasingly familiar in technology, where founders often use dual- or multi-class share structures to maintain strategic control after going public.
For prospective Anthropic investors, the governance structure could become nearly as important as the valuation.

A 50.1% founder voting bloc would give Amodei and his co-founders significant protection from outside shareholder pressure, potentially allowing them to maintain a long-term approach toward AI development and safety.
The other side is weaker shareholder influence over major corporate decisions.
Investors should watch the final voting structure, any sunset provisions, employee voting rights and the precise limits placed on founder control.
Anthropic's IPO timing also remains fluid. Recent reporting has put a potential launch around October or later, with plans still subject to change.

title: Anthropic Seeks Palantir-Style Control Ahead of IPO
